meaning.zh:
“暴怒” 或 “大发脾气”。

这个短语源自电路中的熔断器。当电路过载时，熔断器会断开电路以防止损坏。比喻人们在情绪过载时 “爆发”，表现出极端的愤怒和情绪失控。通常用来形容在某一时刻突然失去冷静、暴跳如雷的人。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the electrical circuit concept where a fuse blows (or breaks) to prevent damage when overloaded. Metaphorically, it describes someone suddenly losing their temper and showing extreme anger, similar to an electrical overload causing a fuse to break. It is often used to depict someone suddenly becoming very angry and losing their composure.

lines.en: When he saw the mess in the kitchen, he totally *blew a fuse*.
lines.zh: 当他看到厨房的混乱时，他彻底暴怒了。

lines.en: She *blew a fuse* when her computer crashed and she lost her work.
lines.zh: 当她的电脑崩溃并丢失工作时，她大发脾气。

lines.en: He *blew a fuse* after hearing the disappointing news.
lines.zh: 在听到令人失望的消息后，他暴跳如雷。
